title: Jonah and the Bell
author: Oscar Eastwick
blurb: August Voss, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
